MassDB SQL 2.0.5-rc02 — product version and source mapping

MassDB SQL uses independent product version numbers. Its 2.0.5-rc02 number must
not be used as an Apache Doris version when assigning package identifiers or
matching vulnerabilities.

Version display: the legal page shows MassDB V2.0.5. SQL @@version_comment
returns massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc02 without a Git hash. FE and BE heartbeat versions use
the same value in SHOW FRONTENDS / BACKENDS and SHOW PROC '/frontends' / '/backends'.
The FE home page, BE home page/footer, version HTTP APIs, FE bootstrap response
and FE version metric label also use massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc02. Each node must run
the updated binary and report a heartbeat. @@version and the MySQL handshake
retain 5.7.99 for client compatibility. Internal build identifiers and package
names retain massdb-sql-2.0.5-rc02, with source identity in the build records.

JDBC catalogs recognize both Doris and MassDB version comments and retain Doris
column type mapping for MassDB targets. Older Doris/MassDB clients or third-party
tools that identify servers only by the word "doris" require a corresponding
client-side update; the new product version does not change their detection rules.
JDBC array decoding also preserves exact large integers, including nested arrays,
instead of rounding them through an intermediate floating-point value.
Array reads and JDBC insert-select copies retain NULL elements, nested NULL arrays,
floating-point signed zero and timestamp fractions at precisions 0 through 6.
Parameterized array elements use the precision, scale and length in the Doris type
declaration instead of the outer array column's JDBC metadata.

Upstream source baseline: Apache Doris 4.0.5-rc01 source version on branch-4.0.
Upstream commit: 59de8c4c524008e8ab2e43b79312f716a3a423a8
Source: https://github.com/apache/doris/commit/59de8c4c524008e8ab2e43b79312f716a3a423a8
This records a source baseline, not a claim that MassDB is an ASF release.
Evaluate vulnerability applicability against actual dependency versions,
upstream code, local changes and backported fixes.

Modifications from the upstream baseline include MassDB branding and web pages,
SQL/search and transaction/report handling changes, selected upstream backports,
and build/deployment adjustments. The FE/UI logos, favicon and login background
have been replaced. The interface adds company attribution, local third-party
notices and transparent copyright footers.

Changes in rc02: align the Playground sidebar and editor heights, reserve footer
space within the viewport, and align the search and refresh controls. The sidebar
resizes with the editor and adapts to narrow screens. Simplify the company footer;
the notices page and NOTICE retain the full copyright scope.

File-level modification notices remain in the distributed scripts and source.
References to MODIFICATIONS.md in source headers refer to the detailed history
in the source repository; that development record is not a runtime dependency.

版本说明：MassDB SQL 2.0.5-rc02 是产品独立编号，上游源码基线为 Apache Doris
4.0.5-rc01。SBOM/CVE 评估须使用实际组件版本和代码差异，不把产品编号作为上游版本。

版本展示：版权声明页显示 MassDB V2.0.5；@@version_comment 返回
massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc02，不追加 Git 哈希。SHOW FRONTENDS / BACKENDS 和
SHOW PROC '/frontends' / '/backends' 的 Version 列使用相同版本；各节点需更新
程序并完成心跳上报。FE 首页、BE 首页与页尾、版本 HTTP 接口、FE 启动状态
接口和版本监控标签也统一为 massdb-2.0.5-sql-rc02。@@version 和 MySQL 握手保持 5.7.99，
用于客户端兼容。内部构建与安装包编号仍为 massdb-sql-2.0.5-rc02，构建记录保留源码信息。

JDBC catalog 同时识别 Doris 和 MassDB 版本声明，连接 MassDB 时保留 Doris 列类型映射。
旧版 Doris/MassDB 客户端或仅凭 "doris" 识别数据库的第三方工具，需同步更新其识别逻辑。
同时修复 JDBC 数组解码经浮点数中转导致的大整数精度丢失，涵盖嵌套数组。
数组读取及 JDBC 查询后写入保留 NULL 元素、嵌套 NULL 数组、浮点负零和 0–6 位时间精度。
数组元素的小数精度、标度及字符串长度从 Doris 完整类型声明读取，避免误用外层列元数据。

修改说明：包含 MassDB 品牌与页面、SQL/搜索及事务/报告处理调整、上游补丁回移，
以及构建部署修改。FE/UI 的 Logo、favicon 和登录背景已替换，增加公司署名、
本地开源声明和透明页脚。详细开发记录保留在源码仓库的 MODIFICATIONS.md。

rc02 更新：Playground 左右面板等高，页脚在视口内统一预留空间；搜索框与刷新
按钮对齐，侧栏拖动时编辑器随之调整，并适配窄屏显示。简化公司页脚文案，
完整版权范围说明保留于声明页和 NOTICE。
